raw: No more than two people may ride on a motorcycle, excluding anyone in an attached sidecar.
formatted: **No more than two people** may ride on a motorcycle, excluding anyone in an **attached sidecar**.

raw: A passenger may only be carried if the motorcycle's engine exceeds 50cc, and the passenger must be seated in a sidecar or astride a pillion.
formatted:
A passenger may only be carried if:
(i) the motorcycle's **engine exceeds 50cc**, and
(ii) the passenger is **seated in a sidecar** or **astride a pillion**.

raw: No more than two adults may be carried in a sidecar attached to a motorcycle.
formatted: **No more than two adults** may be carried in a **sidecar attached** to a motorcycle.

raw: Neither the rider nor passenger may take hold of another vehicle that is in motion.
formatted: Neither the rider nor passenger may **take hold of another vehicle** that is **in motion**.

raw: All wheels of the motorcycle must stay in contact with the road surface at all times.
formatted: **All wheels** of the motorcycle must **stay in contact** with the road surface at all times.

raw: A person may not drive a motor vehicle of a prescribed class without a professional driving permit (kept with them in the vehicle), except a learner accompanied by someone registered as a professional driver for that class.
formatted: A person may not drive a motor vehicle of a prescribed class without a **professional driving permit** (kept with them in the vehicle), except a **learner accompanied** by someone registered as a **professional driver** for that class.

raw: A vehicle may not be operated on a public road in a manner that causes excessive noise.
formatted: A vehicle may not be operated on a public road in a manner that causes **excessive noise**.

raw: Riders must travel in single file within the same lane, except briefly to overtake another motorcycle; two motorcycles may not overtake another vehicle at the same time.
formatted:
Riders must:
(i) travel in **single file** within the same lane, except briefly to **overtake another motorcycle**, and
(ii) ensure **two motorcycles do not overtake** another vehicle at the same time.

raw: A sidecar must be attached to the left side of the motorcycle, and may not be fitted to a motorcycle with an engine under 50cc.
formatted:
A sidecar must:
(i) be attached to the **left side** of the motorcycle, and
(ii) **not be fitted** to a motorcycle with an engine **under 50cc**.

raw: A driver must yield right of way, slow down, or stop for a pedestrian crossing a roadway within a pedestrian crossing.
formatted: A driver must **yield right of way**, **slow down**, or **stop** for a pedestrian crossing a roadway within a pedestrian crossing.

raw: A driver may not pass a vehicle that has stopped at a pedestrian crossing.
formatted: A driver **may not pass** a vehicle that has **stopped at a pedestrian crossing**.

raw: Pedestrians may not cross while the red man light is showing; if the red man flashes, pedestrians already in the road must finish crossing quickly, while those not yet in the road must wait for the green man.
formatted:
Pedestrian signal rules:
(i) pedestrians **may not cross** while the **red man light** is showing,
(ii) if the **red man flashes**, pedestrians already in the road must **finish crossing quickly**, and
(iii) those not yet in the road must **wait for the green man**.

raw: A vehicle left in the same place for more than 24 hours (outside an urban area) or 7 days (within an urban area) is deemed abandoned by its owner.
formatted:
A vehicle is deemed **abandoned by its owner** if left in the same place for:
(i) more than **24 hours** outside an urban area, or
(ii) more than **7 days** within an urban area.

raw: Don't cause a vehicle's wheel to drag or spin on the roadway (except in an emergency), use chocks or shoes between a moving wheel and the road surface, or otherwise use or move a vehicle in a way that damages the road.
formatted:
Do not:
(i) cause a vehicle's **wheel to drag or spin** on the roadway (except in an emergency),
(ii) use **chocks or shoes** between a moving wheel and the road surface, or
(iii) use or move a vehicle in a way that **damages the road**.

raw: Animal-drawn vehicles, pedal cycles, motorcycles under 50cc or electrically propelled, motor quadrucycles, disability vehicles under 230kg, and tractors (outside road construction or maintenance use) may not use a freeway.
formatted:
The following **may not use a freeway**:
(i) **animal-drawn vehicles** and **pedal cycles**,
(ii) **motorcycles under 50cc** or electrically propelled, **motor quadrucycles**, and **disability vehicles under 230kg**, and
(iii) **tractors** (outside road construction or maintenance use).

raw: A parking brake is a brake, normally a hand brake, used to keep a vehicle stationary.
formatted: A **parking brake** is a brake, normally a **hand brake**, used to keep a vehicle **stationary**.

raw: The towed vehicle's steering must be controlled by a person licensed to drive that class of vehicle.
formatted: The towed vehicle's **steering must be controlled** by a person **licensed to drive** that class of vehicle.

raw: If the towed vehicle's brakes don't comply with requirements, it must be connected by a draw-bar or tow-bar rather than a rope or chain.
formatted: If the towed vehicle's **brakes don't comply** with requirements, it must be connected by a **draw-bar or tow-bar** rather than a rope or chain.

raw: A drawing vehicle may tow a maximum of two trailers, or one other motor vehicle that isn't a trailer.
formatted:
A drawing vehicle may tow:
(i) a maximum of **two trailers**, or
(ii) **one other motor vehicle** that isn't a trailer.

raw: In an emergency, it is permitted to tow one other motor vehicle (not a trailer) together with a trailer.
formatted: In an **emergency**, it is permitted to tow **one other motor vehicle** (not a trailer) together with a trailer.

raw: Don't cross or enter a public road unless it's clear of moving traffic for a sufficient distance, or you can do so with safety to yourself and other traffic.
formatted:
Don't **cross or enter** a public road unless:
(i) it's **clear of moving traffic** for a sufficient distance, or
(ii) you can do so **with safety** to yourself and other traffic.

raw: A light motor vehicle's tyres must show a clearly visible tread pattern across the full breadth and circumference, at least 1mm deep.
formatted: A light motor vehicle's tyres must show a **clearly visible tread pattern** across the full breadth and circumference, at least **1mm deep**.

raw: A light motor vehicle may not drive on the shoulder of a public road, except between sunrise and sunset, while being overtaken on a single-lane-each-way road, if it can be done safely, and if visibility is at least 150 metres.
formatted:
A light motor vehicle **may not drive on the shoulder** of a public road, except:
(i) between **sunrise and sunset**,
(ii) while **being overtaken** on a single-lane-each-way road,
(iii) if it can be **done safely**, and
(iv) if visibility is **at least 150 metres**.

raw: Passing on the left is allowed, if it can be done safely, when the vehicle ahead is turning right or has signalled to; on a one-way urban road wide enough for two or more lanes; on an urban road wide enough for two or more lanes each way; where signs designate lanes on a one-way road; or under a traffic officer's direction.
formatted:
Passing on the left is allowed, if it can be done safely:
(i) when the vehicle ahead is **turning right** or has signalled to,
(ii) on a **one-way urban road** wide enough for two or more lanes,
(iii) on an **urban road** wide enough for two or more lanes each way,
(iv) where **signs designate lanes** on a one-way road, or
(v) under a **traffic officer's direction**.

raw: At a junction where vehicles must move around a traffic island, give way to all traffic approaching from your right, unless a traffic officer or road sign directs you otherwise.
formatted: At a junction where vehicles must move around a **traffic island**, **give way to all traffic** approaching from your right, unless a **traffic officer or road sign** directs you otherwise.

raw: Don't park where a traffic officer directs otherwise, in contravention of a sign, where stopping isn't permitted, where the vehicle would obscure a road sign, on the sidewalk, or blocking a private or public vehicular entrance.
formatted:
Don't park:
(i) where a **traffic officer directs otherwise** or in **contravention of a sign**,
(ii) where **stopping isn't permitted** or where the vehicle would **obscure a road sign**, or
(iii) **on the sidewalk** or blocking a **private or public vehicular entrance**.

raw: Don't stop alongside or opposite an excavation or obstruction if it would obstruct or endanger traffic, in a tunnel, subway, or on a bridge (or within 6 metres of one), where the roadway has been narrowed (or within 6 metres of the narrowing), in contravention of a sign, facing oncoming traffic on the right side, alongside another vehicle on a road under 9 metres wide, within a railway level crossing, within 9 metres of a pedestrian crossing's approach side, or anywhere it would endanger or obstruct traffic.
formatted:
Don't stop:
(i) alongside or opposite an **excavation or obstruction** if it would obstruct traffic,
(ii) in a **tunnel, subway, or on a bridge** (or within 6 metres of one),
(iii) where the roadway has been **narrowed** (or within 6 metres of the narrowing),
(iv) in **contravention of a sign** or facing oncoming traffic on the **right side**,
(v) alongside another vehicle on a road **under 9 metres wide**,
(vi) within a **railway level crossing** or within **9 metres of a pedestrian crossing's** approach side, or
(vii) anywhere it would **endanger or obstruct traffic**.

raw: Don't let the engine emit abnormal smoke or fumes, run while the vehicle is stationary and unattended, or run while fuel is being delivered into the tank.
formatted:
Don't let the engine:
(i) emit **abnormal smoke or fumes**,
(ii) run while the vehicle is **stationary and unattended**, or
(iii) run while **fuel is being delivered** into the tank.

raw: A rider may not carry a person, animal, or bulky object in front of them; a non-bulky object may be carried if securely attached and doesn't obstruct the rider's view or control.
formatted:
Motorcycle carrying rules:
(i) a rider **may not carry** a person, animal, or **bulky object in front** of them, and
(ii) a **non-bulky object** may be carried if **securely attached** and doesn't **obstruct view or control**.

raw: Don't stop on a freeway except by sign or traffic officer direction, in a designated stopping/parking area, or for reasons beyond your control.
formatted:
Don't **stop on a freeway** except:
(i) by **sign or traffic officer** direction,
(ii) in a **designated stopping/parking area**, or
(iii) for **reasons beyond your control**.

raw: Stop as directed by a road traffic sign or a uniformed traffic officer, at the request or signal of a person leading livestock (cattle, horse, donkey, mule, sheep, goat, pig, or ostrich), or when animals are crossing the road -- only proceeding once all have crossed and it's safe.
formatted:
Stop:
(i) as directed by a **road traffic sign** or a uniformed **traffic officer**,
(ii) at the request or signal of a person **leading livestock** (cattle, horse, donkey, mule, sheep, goat, pig, or ostrich), or
(iii) when **animals are crossing** the road -- only proceeding once all have crossed and **it's safe**.

raw: Don't drive, or occupy the driver's seat with the engine running, while under the influence of intoxicating liquor or a narcotic drug.
formatted: Don't **drive**, or occupy the driver's seat with the **engine running**, while under the influence of **intoxicating liquor or a narcotic drug**.

raw: A heavy motor vehicle may not be used if its fuel tank, carburettor, or fuel pipes are defective or exposed as a danger, if the fuel tank lacks an effective cap, or if the electrical wiring and battery aren't properly installed, insulated, and maintained.
formatted:
A heavy motor vehicle may not be used if:
(i) its **fuel tank, carburettor, or fuel pipes** are defective or exposed as a danger,
(ii) the fuel tank **lacks an effective cap**, or
(iii) the **electrical wiring and battery** aren't properly installed, insulated, and maintained.

raw: A junction is the portion of an intersection within the lateral limits of the intersecting roadways, including any stop or yield line marking painted there.
formatted: A **junction** is the portion of an intersection within the **lateral limits** of the intersecting roadways, including any **stop or yield line marking** painted there.

raw: A professional driver drives a motor vehicle of a prescribed class and must hold a professional driving permit; this doesn't apply to a learner accompanied by a registered professional driver for that class.
formatted: A **professional driver** drives a motor vehicle of a prescribed class and must hold a **professional driving permit**; this doesn't apply to a **learner accompanied** by a registered professional driver for that class.

raw: A vehicle is a device designed mainly to travel on wheels or crawler tracks (excluding devices that move solely on rails).
formatted: A **vehicle** is a device designed mainly to **travel on wheels or crawler tracks** (excluding devices that move solely on rails).

raw: Don't drive, pull, or push a vehicle on a sidewalk.
formatted: Don't **drive, pull, or push** a vehicle on a **sidewalk**.

raw: A Code 2 learner's licence authorises driving any motor vehicle or combination (other than a motorcycle or tricycle) with tare, GVM, or GCM not exceeding 3500kg, only under the direct supervision of a licensed driver for that class. Minimum age is 17; valid for 24 months from the test date.
formatted:
A **Code 2 learner's licence**:
(i) authorises driving any motor vehicle or combination (other than a motorcycle or tricycle) with tare, GVM, or GCM **not exceeding 3500kg**,
(ii) requires **direct supervision** of a licensed driver for that class,
(iii) requires a **minimum age of 17**, and
(iv) is **valid for 24 months** from the test date.

raw: A Code 3 learner's licence authorises driving any motor vehicle or combination (other than a motorcycle, tricycle, or quadrucycle) -- covering both light and heavy vehicles -- only under the direct supervision of a licensed driver for that class. Minimum age is 18; valid for 24 months from the test date.
formatted:
A **Code 3 learner's licence**:
(i) authorises driving any motor vehicle or combination (other than a motorcycle, tricycle, or quadrucycle) covering **light and heavy vehicles**,
(ii) requires **direct supervision** of a licensed driver for that class,
(iii) requires a **minimum age of 18**, and
(iv) is **valid for 24 months** from the test date.

raw: A motorcycle's lamps must be undamaged, properly secured, and capable of being lit at all times.
formatted: A motorcycle's lamps must be **undamaged**, **properly secured**, and **capable of being lit** at all times.

raw: To 'stop' means to bring a vehicle to a standstill.
formatted: To **'stop'** means to bring a vehicle to a **standstill**.

raw: Dip your main beam for oncoming traffic, and when following another vehicle.
formatted: Dip your main beam for **oncoming traffic**, and when **following another vehicle**.

raw: Every headlamp on dipped beam must adequately illuminate the road ahead, enabling the driver to see a person, vehicle, or substantial object at least 45 metres away.
formatted: Every headlamp on dipped beam must **adequately illuminate** the road ahead, enabling the driver to see a person, vehicle, or substantial object **at least 45 metres** away.

raw: A vehicle may not be driven in motion using only its parking lamps.
formatted: A vehicle may **not be driven in motion** using only its **parking lamps**.

raw: A motorcycle or motor tricycle must be fitted with a rear lamp emitting red light.
formatted: A motorcycle or motor tricycle must be fitted with a **rear lamp emitting red light**.

raw: A light motor vehicle must be fitted with rear lamps emitting red light.
formatted: A light motor vehicle must be fitted with **rear lamps emitting red light**.

raw: A heavy motor vehicle must be fitted with at least one rear lamp on each side emitting red light.
formatted: A heavy motor vehicle must be fitted with at least **one rear lamp on each side** emitting **red light**.

raw: A light motor vehicle or motorcycle must have rear stop lamps that emit a red light brighter than the rear lamps, visible at 30 metres in normal sunlight.
formatted: A light motor vehicle or motorcycle must have **rear stop lamps** that emit a **red light brighter** than the rear lamps, visible at **30 metres in normal sunlight**.

raw: A heavy motor vehicle must have at least one stop lamp on each side at the rear, meeting the same brightness and visibility requirements.
formatted: A heavy motor vehicle must have at least **one stop lamp on each side** at the rear, meeting the same **brightness and visibility** requirements.

raw: An illuminated stop lamp indicates the vehicle is decreasing speed and may stop.
formatted: An **illuminated stop lamp** indicates the vehicle is **decreasing speed** and **may stop**.

raw: A vehicle must have at least one number-plate lamp at the rear, making every letter and figure on the plate visible from 20 metres by a person of normal eyesight.
formatted: A vehicle must have at least **one number-plate lamp** at the rear, making every letter and figure on the plate **visible from 20 metres** by a person of normal eyesight.

raw: A number plate must be SABS-approved and fitted so it cannot easily be detached.
formatted: A number plate must be **SABS-approved** and fitted so it **cannot easily be detached**.

raw: A number plate must be upright (or within 30 degrees), with every letter and figure clearly legible and the whole plate visible.
formatted: A number plate must be **upright (or within 30 degrees)**, with every letter and figure **clearly legible** and the **whole plate visible**.

raw: Motorcycles, motor tricycles, and trailers need only a rear number plate; all other motor vehicles need one at the front and one at the rear.
formatted:
Number plate requirements:
(i) motorcycles, motor tricycles, and trailers need only a **rear number plate**, and
(ii) all other motor vehicles need **one at the front and one at the rear**.

raw: Fog lamps may only be lit in conditions of poor visibility caused by snow, fog, mist, dust, or smoke.
formatted: Fog lamps may only be lit in **conditions of poor visibility** caused by **snow, fog, mist, dust, or smoke**.

raw: A driver must have a full, clear view of the road ahead, and to the left and right, while the vehicle is in use.
formatted: A driver must have a **full, clear view** of the road ahead, and to the **left and right**, while the vehicle is in use.

raw: A light or heavy motor vehicle's steering gear must be maintained in a condition that allows the vehicle to be steered safely and efficiently.
formatted: A light or heavy motor vehicle's **steering gear** must be maintained in a condition that allows the vehicle to be **steered safely and efficiently**.

raw: The tow-rope, chain, or tow-bar between two vehicles may not exceed 3.5 metres in length.
formatted: The tow-rope, chain, or tow-bar between two vehicles **may not exceed 3.5 metres** in length.

raw: A motorcycle must have two independent, working braking systems -- one acting on the front wheel, one on the rear wheel(s).
formatted: A motorcycle must have **two independent, working braking systems** -- one acting on the **front wheel**, one on the **rear wheel(s)**.

raw: A light or heavy motor vehicle must be equipped with a working service brake, parking brake, and emergency brake (the emergency and parking brake may be one and the same).
formatted: A light or heavy motor vehicle must be equipped with a working **service brake**, **parking brake**, and **emergency brake** (the emergency and parking brake may be one and the same).

raw: A hooter may only be used when necessary on the grounds of safety.
formatted: A hooter may **only be used** when necessary on the **grounds of safety**.

raw: A light motor vehicle must have a working hooter, audible by a person of normal hearing from 90 metres.
formatted: A light motor vehicle must have a **working hooter**, audible by a person of normal hearing from **90 metres**.

raw: A tune-playing siren or horn may not be used on a private vehicle.
formatted: A **tune-playing siren or horn** may not be used on a **private vehicle**.

raw: A driver must immediately give way to any emergency vehicle sounding a siren and displaying warning lights.
formatted: A driver must **immediately give way** to any emergency vehicle sounding a **siren and displaying warning lights**.

raw: Emergency vehicles include fire-fighting, rescue, and emergency medical/ambulance vehicles (red light), a vehicle driven by a traffic officer on duty (blue light), and a vehicle engaged in civil protection (green light).
formatted:
Emergency vehicles include:
(i) fire-fighting, rescue, and emergency medical/ambulance vehicles (**red light**),
(ii) a vehicle driven by a traffic officer on duty (**blue light**), and
(iii) a vehicle engaged in civil protection (**green light**).

raw: Seatbelts are compulsory for children and adults aged 3 and older while the vehicle is moving forward.
formatted: Seatbelts are **compulsory for children and adults** aged 3 and older while the vehicle is **moving forward**.

raw: If seatbelts are fitted, rear-seat passengers must wear them while the vehicle is being driven.
formatted: If seatbelts are fitted, **rear-seat passengers must wear them** while the vehicle is being driven.

raw: A child is defined as aged 3 to 14, unless taller than 1.5 metres, in which case they're treated as an adult regardless of age.
formatted: A child is defined as **aged 3 to 14**, unless **taller than 1.5 metres**, in which case they're treated as an **adult regardless of age**.

raw: An adult may not occupy a seat without wearing a seatbelt, nor a seat on a row without seatbelts if a belted seat on that row is available.
formatted:
An adult may not occupy:
(i) a seat **without wearing a seatbelt**, nor
(ii) a seat on a row without seatbelts if a **belted seat on that row is available**.

raw: A driver must ensure a child uses an appropriate child restraint where available, or a seatbelt if no restraint is available; if no belted seat is available and the vehicle has a rear seat, the child must sit there.
formatted:
A driver must ensure:
(i) a child uses an **appropriate child restraint** where available, or a **seatbelt** if no restraint is available, and
(ii) if no belted seat is available and the vehicle has a rear seat, the child must **sit there**.

raw: It is not compulsory to wear a seatbelt while reversing or moving in or out of a parking bay or area.
formatted: It is **not compulsory** to wear a seatbelt while **reversing** or moving in or out of a **parking bay or area**.

raw: A motorcycle, tricycle, or quadrucycle rider and any passenger (including a sidecar passenger) must wear a properly fitted, purpose-designed protective helmet with the chin strap fastened.
formatted: A motorcycle, tricycle, or quadrucycle rider and any passenger (including a sidecar passenger) must wear a **properly fitted, purpose-designed protective helmet** with the **chin strap fastened**.

raw: A rider must ensure any passenger under 14 years old also wears a protective helmet.
formatted: A rider must ensure any passenger **under 14 years old** also wears a **protective helmet**.

raw: A driver passing a stationary bus must do so with due care for people approaching or leaving it.
formatted: A driver passing a **stationary bus** must do so with **due care** for people approaching or leaving it.

raw: A vehicle must have an efficient exhaust silencer that channels exhaust gas through it.
formatted: A vehicle must have an **efficient exhaust silencer** that channels exhaust gas through it.

raw: Exhaust smoke may not be dense enough to be a nuisance, or to obstruct other road users' vision.
formatted: Exhaust smoke **may not be dense enough** to be a **nuisance**, or to **obstruct other road users' vision**.

raw: The exhaust may not be positioned where oil or flammable liquid could drip onto it, and may not leak gas or smoke into the cab or passenger compartment.
formatted:
The exhaust:
(i) may **not be positioned** where oil or flammable liquid could drip onto it, and
(ii) may **not leak gas or smoke** into the cab or passenger compartment.

raw: A light or heavy motor vehicle's engine must be covered so that it isn't a source of danger.
formatted: A light or heavy motor vehicle's **engine must be covered** so that it isn't a **source of danger**.

raw: Heavy motor vehicles, goods vehicles, minibuses, and buses (but not motor cars, ambulances, or motorcycles) must carry at least one emergency warning triangle.
formatted: Heavy motor vehicles, goods vehicles, minibuses, and buses (but not motor cars, ambulances, or motorcycles) must carry at least **one emergency warning triangle**.

raw: For a combination of vehicles, the warning triangle for each vehicle in the combination may all be carried on the drawing vehicle.
formatted: For a combination of vehicles, the warning triangle for **each vehicle** in the combination may **all be carried on the drawing vehicle**.

raw: Don't give a hand signal on a freeway (except for reasons beyond your control), be on a freeway on foot, or leave an animal where it could stray onto one.
formatted:
Freeway restrictions:
(i) don't give a **hand signal** on a freeway (except for reasons beyond your control),
(ii) don't be on a **freeway on foot**, and
(iii) don't leave an **animal** where it could stray onto one.

raw: A stationary vehicle must place a warning triangle at least 45 metres away in the direction traffic will approach from, at roughly the same distance from the roadway edge as the vehicle's own centre, with the reflective side facing oncoming traffic.
formatted:
A stationary vehicle must place a warning triangle:
(i) at least **45 metres away** in the direction traffic will approach from,
(ii) at roughly the **same distance from the roadway edge** as the vehicle's own centre, and
(iii) with the **reflective side facing oncoming traffic**.

raw: A warning triangle isn't required if the vehicle is stopped in a loading zone, on a traffic officer's or sign's direction, because of other traffic while the driver stays in the driving seat, or during a state or municipal function.
formatted:
A warning triangle isn't required if the vehicle is stopped:
(i) in a **loading zone** or on a **traffic officer's or sign's direction**,
(ii) because of other traffic while the driver **stays in the driving seat**, or
(iii) during a **state or municipal function**.

raw: A vehicle capable of reaching 60 km/h or more must be equipped with a working speedometer.
formatted: A vehicle capable of reaching **60 km/h or more** must be equipped with a **working speedometer**.

raw: A general speed limit applies to all roads even without a sign: 60 km/h in urban areas, 100 km/h on non-freeway roads outside urban areas, and 120 km/h on freeways, unless a sign indicates otherwise.
formatted:
A general speed limit applies to all roads even without a sign:
(i) **60 km/h** in urban areas,
(ii) **100 km/h** on non-freeway roads outside urban areas, and
(iii) **120 km/h** on freeways, unless a sign indicates otherwise.

raw: Exceeding the applicable speed limit is an offence.
formatted: Exceeding the applicable speed limit is an **offence**.

raw: Buses and minibuses conveying persons for reward have a speed limit of 100 km/h.
formatted: Buses and minibuses conveying persons for reward have a speed limit of **100 km/h**.

raw: An 80 km/h speed limit applies to a goods vehicle with a GVM over 9000kg, a combination where the combined GVM of the goods vehicle and trailer(s) exceeds 9000kg, an articulated vehicle whose truck-tractor GCM exceeds 9000kg, and any breakdown vehicle towing another vehicle.
formatted:
An **80 km/h speed limit** applies to:
(i) a **goods vehicle** with a GVM over 9000kg,
(ii) a combination where the **combined GVM** of the goods vehicle and trailer(s) exceeds 9000kg,
(iii) an articulated vehicle whose **truck-tractor GCM exceeds 9000kg**, and
(iv) any **breakdown vehicle** towing another vehicle.

raw: A double-deck bus (with load) may not exceed 4.65 metres in height; any other motor vehicle may not exceed 4.3 metres.
formatted:
Maximum vehicle height limits:
(i) a **double-deck bus** (with load) may not exceed **4.65 metres** in height, and
(ii) any **other motor vehicle** may not exceed **4.3 metres**.

raw: A bus with a front wheel track over 1.9 metres may not exceed 2.6 metres overall width; a goods vehicle of 12,000kg GVM or more may not exceed 2.6 metres; any other vehicle may not exceed 2.5 metres.
formatted:
Maximum overall width limits:
(i) a bus with a front wheel track over 1.9 metres may not exceed **2.6 metres**,
(ii) a goods vehicle of 12,000kg GVM or more may not exceed **2.6 metres**, and
(iii) any other vehicle may not exceed **2.5 metres**.

raw: Goods must be safely contained within, or securely fastened to, the vehicle, and protected from falling or spilling.
formatted: Goods must be **safely contained** within, or **securely fastened** to, the vehicle, and **protected from falling or spilling**.

raw: On a motor car's roof, goods may not exceed half the car's height measured from ground level, except pedal cycles.
formatted: On a motor car's roof, goods **may not exceed half the car's height** measured from ground level, **except pedal cycles**.

raw: A shipping container fitted with twist-lock provisions must be secured with at least four twist locks.
formatted: A shipping container fitted with twist-lock provisions must be secured with **at least four twist locks**.

raw: Baggage on a motorcycle should be placed in carriers securely attached to the motorcycle.
formatted: Baggage on a motorcycle should be placed in **carriers securely attached** to the motorcycle.

raw: The section of a goods vehicle carrying persons must be enclosed to at least 350mm above a seated person, or 900mm above a standing person.
formatted:
The section of a goods vehicle carrying persons must be enclosed to:
(i) at least **350mm above a seated person**, or
(ii) at least **900mm above a standing person**.

raw: It is against the law for passengers to ride in a caravan.
formatted: It is against the law for **passengers to ride in a caravan**.

raw: A motorcycle's load (or sidecar load) may not project more than 600mm in front of the front axle, 900mm behind the rear axle, 450mm to either side, or 300mm beyond the sidecar wheel.
formatted:
A motorcycle's load (or sidecar load) may not project:
(i) more than **600mm in front** of the front axle,
(ii) more than **900mm behind** the rear axle,
(iii) more than **450mm to either side**, or
(iv) more than **300mm beyond** the sidecar wheel.

raw: A light or heavy vehicle's goods may not project sideways from the centre-line by more than 1.3 metres (bus or goods vehicle over 12,000kg GVM) or 1.25 metres (any other vehicle), excluding mirrors or indicators.
formatted:
A light or heavy vehicle's goods may not project sideways from the centre-line by:
(i) more than **1.3 metres** (bus or goods vehicle over 12,000kg GVM), or
(ii) more than **1.25 metres** (any other vehicle), excluding mirrors or indicators.

raw: A light or heavy vehicle's goods may not project more than 300mm beyond the front of the vehicle, or 1.8 metres beyond the rear.
formatted:
A light or heavy vehicle's goods may not project:
(i) more than **300mm beyond the front** of the vehicle, or
(ii) more than **1.8 metres beyond the rear**.

raw: A load projecting more than 150mm to the side, or 300mm to the rear, must be marked with a red flag (300mm x 300mm) during the day, and white (front) or red (rear) retro-reflectors at night or whenever visibility is poor.
formatted:
A load projecting more than **150mm to the side** or **300mm to the rear** must be marked with:
(i) a **red flag (300mm x 300mm)** during the day, and
(ii) **white (front) or red (rear) retro-reflectors** at night or whenever visibility is poor.

raw: On a public road divided into two or more roadways, drive only on the left-hand roadway, unless directed or permitted otherwise by a road traffic sign or a traffic officer.
formatted: On a public road divided into two or more roadways, **drive only on the left-hand roadway**, unless directed or permitted otherwise by a **road traffic sign or a traffic officer**.

raw: Drive on the left side of the roadway, without encroaching right, unless it can be done safely or you're directed otherwise by a sign or traffic officer.
formatted: Drive on the **left side of the roadway**, without **encroaching right**, unless it can be done safely or you're directed otherwise by a sign or traffic officer.

raw: When another vehicle wants to pass you, keep as near to the left edge of the roadway as is safely possible, and don't speed up until it has passed.
formatted: When another vehicle wants to pass you, keep as **near to the left edge** of the roadway as is safely possible, and **don't speed up** until it has passed.

raw: When passing oncoming traffic, don't encroach onto the roadway to your right in a way that obstructs or endangers it.
formatted: When passing oncoming traffic, **don't encroach onto the roadway to your right** in a way that **obstructs or endangers** it.

raw: Direction indicators must be used every time you turn left or right, or change lanes.
formatted: Direction indicators **must be used** every time you **turn left or right**, or **change lanes**.

raw: A light motor vehicle's indicators must flash intermittently, be clearly visible at 30 metres in daylight, and show white, yellow, or amber light to the front, and yellow, amber, or red light to the rear.
formatted:
A light motor vehicle's indicators must:
(i) **flash intermittently**,
(ii) be clearly **visible at 30 metres** in daylight, and
(iii) show **white, yellow, or amber light** to the front, and **yellow, amber, or red light** to the rear.

raw: A motorcycle, motorcycle with sidecar, or motor tricycle must have a red retro-reflector fitted at the rear.
formatted: A motorcycle, motorcycle with sidecar, or motor tricycle must have a **red retro-reflector fitted at the rear**.

raw: A light motor vehicle must have two red retro-reflectors at the rear, one on each side.
formatted: A light motor vehicle must have **two red retro-reflectors** at the rear, **one on each side**.

raw: A heavy motor vehicle must have two red retro-reflectors at the same height at the rear, one on each side.
formatted: A heavy motor vehicle must have **two red retro-reflectors** at the same height at the rear, **one on each side**.

raw: A heavy vehicle or combination longer than 7 metres must have yellow retro-reflectors along each side, spaced so no two successive ones are more than 3.6 metres apart, unless yellow reflective strips are fitted instead.
formatted: A heavy vehicle or combination longer than 7 metres must have **yellow retro-reflectors along each side**, spaced so no two successive ones are **more than 3.6 metres apart**, unless **yellow reflective strips** are fitted instead.

raw: Since 1 January 2001, a goods vehicle with a GVM over 10,000kg must have yellow reflective material on its sides and rear; it's optional (but permitted) for vehicles under 10,000kg GVM.
formatted: Since 1 January 2001, a goods vehicle with a GVM over 10,000kg **must have yellow reflective material** on its sides and rear; it's **optional (but permitted)** for vehicles under 10,000kg GVM.

raw: Pass another vehicle on the right at a safe distance, and don't return to the left side until safely clear of the vehicle you passed.
formatted: Pass another vehicle on the **right at a safe distance**, and **don't return to the left side** until safely clear of the vehicle you passed.

raw: Exceeding the speed limit while overtaking or passing is not permitted.
formatted: **Exceeding the speed limit** while overtaking or passing is **not permitted**.

raw: Passing may never be done by driving on the shoulder or the verge of a public road.
formatted: Passing may **never be done** by driving on the **shoulder or the verge** of a public road.

raw: Don't pass other traffic when approaching the summit of a rise, a curve, or anywhere visibility is too restricted to see oncoming traffic, unless you can do so without encroaching right, or the road is restricted to one direction.
formatted: Don't pass other traffic when approaching the **summit of a rise**, a **curve**, or anywhere **visibility is too restricted** to see oncoming traffic, unless you can do so without encroaching right, or the road is restricted to one direction.

raw: When another vehicle wants to pass you, keep left and don't accelerate until it has passed.
formatted: When another vehicle wants to pass you, **keep left** and **don't accelerate** until it has passed.

raw: A learner's licence test covers rules of the road and related legislation, road traffic signs/signals/markings, and vehicle controls. Once passed, the learner's licence is valid for 24 months.
formatted:
A learner's licence test covers:
(i) **rules of the road** and related legislation,
(ii) **road traffic signs**, signals, and markings, and
(iii) **vehicle controls**.
Once passed, the learner's licence is **valid for 24 months**.

raw: A person is disqualified from obtaining or holding a licence while addicted to narcotics or excessive alcohol use, while disqualified or suspended by a court or authority, or during a period following cancellation of a previous licence.
formatted:
A person is disqualified from obtaining or holding a licence:
(i) while **addicted to narcotics or excessive alcohol** use,
(ii) while **disqualified or suspended** by a court or authority, or
(iii) during a period **following cancellation** of a previous licence.

raw: A person may not apply for a licence for a class of vehicle they are already licensed to drive under an existing licence.
formatted: A person **may not apply for a licence** for a class of vehicle they are **already licensed to drive** under an existing licence.

raw: A person is disqualified if suffering from uncontrolled epilepsy, disabling giddiness or fainting (e.g. from hypertension), a mental illness requiring detention or treatment, a condition causing muscular incoordination, uncontrolled diabetes mellitus, defective vision below the prescribed standard, or any other disease or defect likely to prevent safe driving. Deafness alone is not disqualifying.
formatted:
A person is disqualified if suffering from:
(i) **uncontrolled epilepsy**, disabling giddiness, or fainting,
(ii) a **mental illness** requiring detention or treatment, or a condition causing **muscular incoordination**,
(iii) **uncontrolled diabetes mellitus**, or **defective vision** below the prescribed standard, or
(iv) any other disease or defect likely to **prevent safe driving**.
Deafness alone is not disqualifying.

raw: A Code 1 learner's licence authorises riding a motorcycle (but not a motor quadrucycle) on a public road. Minimum age is 16; under 18 you're limited to a 125cc engine; no passengers may be carried.
formatted:
A **Code 1 learner's licence**:
(i) authorises **riding a motorcycle** (but not a motor quadrucycle) on a public road,
(ii) requires a **minimum age of 16** (under 18 you're limited to a **125cc engine**), and
(iii) prohibits carrying **any passengers**.

raw: On a light or heavy motor vehicle, all lamps must be undamaged, unobscured, properly secured, and capable of being lit at all times.
formatted: On a light or heavy motor vehicle, all lamps must be **undamaged**, **unobscured**, **properly secured**, and **capable of being lit** at all times.

raw: These lighting rules don't apply to a vehicle parked off the roadway, in a demarcated parking place, or within 12 metres of a lit street lamp illuminating the road.
formatted:
These lighting rules don't apply to a vehicle stopped:
(i) **parked off the roadway**,
(ii) in a **demarcated parking place**, or
(iii) within **12 metres of a lit street lamp** illuminating the road.

raw: Every headlamp on main beam must adequately illuminate the road ahead, enabling the driver to see a person, vehicle, or substantial object at least 100 metres away.
formatted: Every headlamp on main beam must **adequately illuminate** the road ahead, enabling the driver to see a person, vehicle, or substantial object **at least 100 metres** away.

raw: A motorcycle's steering gear must be maintained so it can be steered safely and efficiently, and handlebar width and handgrip height must meet prescribed measurements based on engine capacity.
formatted: A motorcycle's **steering gear** must be maintained so it can be **steered safely and efficiently**, and handlebar width and handgrip height must meet **prescribed measurements** based on engine capacity.

raw: A vehicle's turning radius may not exceed 13.1 metres.
formatted: A vehicle's turning radius **may not exceed 13.1 metres**.

raw: A light motor vehicle's windscreen must give the driver sufficient visibility for safe driving, be made of safety glass, and allow at least 70% light transmittance.
formatted:
A light motor vehicle's windscreen must:
(i) give the driver **sufficient visibility** for safe driving,
(ii) be made of **safety glass**, and
(iii) allow at least **70% light transmittance**.

raw: A light or heavy motor vehicle with a windscreen must have at least one wiper that continuously, evenly, and adequately clears the area directly in front of the driver.
formatted: A light or heavy motor vehicle with a windscreen must have at least **one wiper** that continuously, evenly, and adequately **clears the area** directly in front of the driver.

raw: A light or heavy vehicle may not have a bracket projecting more than 150mm beyond the vehicle's widest part (side mirrors and indicators excepted).
formatted: A light or heavy vehicle may not have a bracket projecting **more than 150mm** beyond the vehicle's widest part (**side mirrors and indicators excepted**).

raw: On a road divided into lanes by markings, don't change lanes unless it can be done without obstructing or endangering other traffic.
formatted: On a road divided into lanes by markings, **don't change lanes** unless it can be done without **obstructing or endangering** other traffic.

raw: Before stopping or turning, give a clear, timely signal of your intention, long enough and visible enough to warn anyone approaching from the front, rear, or side.
formatted: Before stopping or turning, give a **clear, timely signal** of your intention, **long enough and visible enough** to warn anyone approaching from the front, rear, or side.

raw: A motor vehicle must be equipped with flasher-type direction indicators on both sides.
formatted: A motor vehicle must be equipped with **flasher-type direction indicators** on both sides.

raw: Don't park within 1.5 metres of a fire hydrant.
formatted: Don't park within **1.5 metres of a fire hydrant**.

raw: Outside an urban area, don't park on the roadway (excluding the shoulder), or with any part of the vehicle within 1 metre of the roadway edge, except for reasons beyond your control.
formatted: Outside an urban area, **don't park on the roadway** (excluding the shoulder), or with any part of the vehicle **within 1 metre** of the roadway edge, except for reasons beyond your control.

raw: Don't stop on the roadway except to avoid an accident, on a traffic officer's direction, or for reasons beyond your control.
formatted:
Don't **stop on the roadway** except:
(i) to **avoid an accident**,
(ii) on a **traffic officer's direction**, or
(iii) for **reasons beyond your control**.

raw: Don't deposit fuel, oil, grease, or other flammable or offensive matter on or alongside a road.
formatted: Don't deposit **fuel, oil, grease**, or other **flammable or offensive matter** on or alongside a road.

raw: A motorcycle rider must obey every road sign and rule of the road, unless a traffic officer instructs otherwise.
formatted: A motorcycle rider must **obey every road sign** and rule of the road, unless a **traffic officer instructs otherwise**.

raw: A motorcycle may not be used to tow another vehicle.
formatted: A motorcycle **may not be used to tow** another vehicle.

raw: Towing at over 30 km/h with a rope or chain is not allowed -- a draw-bar or tow-bar connection is required instead.
formatted: Towing at **over 30 km/h** with a rope or chain is not allowed -- a **draw-bar or tow-bar connection** is required instead.

raw: A towed vehicle may only carry passengers at over 30 km/h if it is a semi-trailer.
formatted: A towed vehicle may **only carry passengers** at over 30 km/h if it is a **semi-trailer**.

raw: A motorcycle may not be fitted with a retreaded tyre.
formatted: A motorcycle may **not be fitted** with a **retreaded tyre**.

raw: Acceptable identification includes a South African ID document or card, a valid South African passport, a foreign ID or traffic register number certificate (for non-residents), or a driving licence card.
formatted:
Acceptable identification includes:
(i) a **South African ID document or card**,
(ii) a valid **South African passport**,
(iii) a **foreign ID or traffic register number certificate** (for non-residents), or
(iv) a **driving licence card**.

raw: An articulated motor vehicle is a combination of a truck-tractor and a semi-trailer.
formatted: An **articulated motor vehicle** is a combination of a **truck-tractor and a semi-trailer**.

raw: A licence disc is a disc issued under the Act that licenses a vehicle for use on a public road, valid for 12 months.
formatted: A **licence disc** is a disc issued under the Act that licenses a vehicle for use on a public road, **valid for 12 months**.

raw: A midibus is a sub-category of bus designed to carry more than 16 and up to 35 people, including the driver.
formatted: A **midibus** is a sub-category of bus designed to carry **more than 16 and up to 35 people**, including the driver.

raw: A motorcycle is a motor vehicle with two wheels, including one with a sidecar attached.
formatted: A **motorcycle** is a motor vehicle with two wheels, including one with a **sidecar attached**.

raw: A tractor is a motor vehicle designed mainly for drawing other vehicles with a GCM not exceeding 24,000kg; it does not include a truck-tractor.
formatted: A **tractor** is a motor vehicle designed mainly for **drawing other vehicles** with a GCM **not exceeding 24,000kg**; it does not include a truck-tractor.

raw: A trailer is a vehicle not self-propelled, designed to be drawn by a motor vehicle, excluding a motorcycle sidecar.
formatted: A **trailer** is a vehicle not self-propelled, designed to be **drawn by a motor vehicle**, excluding a motorcycle sidecar.

raw: A motor vehicle licence and licence disc are valid for 12 months from the first day of the month of issue; the expiry date is shown on both.
formatted: A motor vehicle licence and licence disc are **valid for 12 months** from the first day of the month of issue; the **expiry date is shown on both**.

raw: A driver wanting to overtake a vehicle ahead (not in the left lane) may signal their intention by flashing their headlights.
formatted: A driver wanting to overtake a vehicle ahead (not in the left lane) may signal their intention by **flashing their headlights**.

raw: On a freeway, keep left and overtake on the right.
formatted: On a freeway, **keep left** and **overtake on the right**.

raw: Within an urban area, don't park within 9 metres of the approach side of a pedestrian crossing, within 5 metres of an intersection, over a traffic signal's mechanism, more than 450mm from the kerb, on a road narrower than 5.5 metres, or on a traffic island, pedestrian mall, or pedestrian lane.
formatted:
Within an urban area, don't park:
(i) within **9 metres** of the approach side of a pedestrian crossing,
(ii) within **5 metres** of an intersection or over a **traffic signal's mechanism**,
(iii) more than **450mm from the kerb** or on a road **narrower than 5.5 metres**, or
(iv) on a **traffic island, pedestrian mall, or pedestrian lane**.

raw: Obey every road traffic sign and rule of the road, unless a traffic officer instructs you otherwise.
formatted: Obey **every road traffic sign** and rule of the road, unless a **traffic officer instructs you otherwise**.

raw: A motorcycle with an engine over 50cc must have tyres showing a clearly visible tread pattern across the full breadth and circumference, at least 1mm deep.
formatted: A motorcycle with an engine **over 50cc** must have tyres showing a **clearly visible tread pattern** across the full breadth and circumference, at least **1mm deep**.

raw: A motorcycle with an engine of 50cc or under may not run a tyre with less than 80% visible tread pattern across the tread width.
formatted: A motorcycle with an engine of **50cc or under** may not run a tyre with **less than 80% visible tread pattern** across the tread width.

raw: If asked by someone with reasonable grounds, a driver must give their name and address, the vehicle owner's name and address, and the vehicle's registration number.
formatted:
If asked by someone with reasonable grounds, a driver must give:
(i) **their name and address**,
(ii) the **vehicle owner's name and address**, and
(iii) the **vehicle's registration number**.

raw: Except on a medical practitioner's instruction, a driver may not consume alcohol or narcotic drugs before reporting an accident.
formatted: Except on a medical practitioner's instruction, a driver **may not consume alcohol or narcotic drugs** before **reporting an accident**.

raw: If a person has been killed or injured and the accident fully obstructs the roadway, a vehicle may not be moved unless its position is clearly marked on the road, or a traffic officer authorises its removal.
formatted:
If a person has been killed or injured and the accident fully obstructs the roadway, a vehicle **may not be moved** unless:
(i) its position is **clearly marked on the road**, or
(ii) a **traffic officer authorises** its removal.

raw: A vehicle damaged in a collision may not be removed from the accident scene without the driver's or owner's permission.
formatted: A vehicle damaged in a collision **may not be removed** from the accident scene without the **driver's or owner's permission**.

raw: Don't drive on a public road without reasonable consideration for other road users.
formatted: Don't drive on a public road without **reasonable consideration** for other road users.

raw: Don't drive recklessly or negligently, or in a manner that wilfully disregards the safety of people or property.
formatted: Don't drive **recklessly or negligently**, or in a manner that **wilfully disregards the safety** of people or property.

raw: Don't drive with a blood alcohol concentration of 0.05g per 100ml or more (0.02g per 100ml or more for a professional driver).
formatted: Don't drive with a blood alcohol concentration of **0.05g per 100ml or more** (**0.02g per 100ml or more** for a professional driver).

raw: A bridge includes a culvert and a causeway.
formatted: A **bridge** includes a **culvert** and a **causeway**.

raw: A bus is a motor vehicle designed or adapted to carry more than 16 people, including the driver.
formatted: A **bus** is a motor vehicle designed or adapted to carry **more than 16 people**, including the driver.

raw: A combination of motor vehicles means two or more motor vehicles coupled together.
formatted: A **combination of motor vehicles** means **two or more motor vehicles coupled together**.

raw: A dedicated lane is a portion of road reserved for certain periods for the exclusive use of certain vehicle categories, as shown by an appropriate sign.
formatted: A **dedicated lane** is a portion of road reserved for certain periods for the **exclusive use of certain vehicle categories**, as shown by an appropriate sign.

raw: A direction indicator is a device fitted to a vehicle allowing the driver to signal an intention to change direction left or right.
formatted: A **direction indicator** is a device fitted to a vehicle allowing the driver to **signal an intention** to change direction left or right.

raw: DLTC stands for Driving Licence Testing Centre, registered under the National Road Traffic Act.
formatted: **DLTC** stands for **Driving Licence Testing Centre**, registered under the National Road Traffic Act.

raw: If these details haven't already been given to a traffic officer at the scene, the accident must be reported to a police station within 24 hours, along with any further information required.
formatted: If details haven't been given to an officer at the scene, the accident must be **reported to a police station within 24 hours**, along with any **further information required**.

raw: A driver is any person who drives or attempts to drive a vehicle, rides or attempts to ride a pedal cycle, or leads a draught, pack, or saddle animal, or a herd or flock of animals.
formatted:
A **driver** is any person who:
(i) **drives or attempts to drive** a vehicle,
(ii) **rides or attempts to ride** a pedal cycle, or
(iii) **leads a draught, pack, or saddle animal**, or a herd or flock of animals.

raw: The edge of the roadway is the boundary between the roadway and the shoulder, as indicated by a sign, or otherwise the edge of the surfaced or improved part of the road.
formatted:
The **edge of the roadway** is:
(i) the **boundary between roadway and shoulder** as indicated by a sign, or
(ii) otherwise the edge of the **surfaced or improved part** of the road.

raw: A freeway is a public road, or section of one, designated as a freeway by an appropriate road traffic sign.
formatted: A **freeway** is a public road, or section of one, **designated as a freeway** by an appropriate road traffic sign.

raw: Goods means any movable property.
formatted: **Goods** means any **movable property**.

raw: A goods vehicle is a motor vehicle (other than a motorcycle, tricycle, quadrucycle, motor car, minibus, or bus) designed to carry goods on a public road; it includes a truck-tractor, adaptor dolly, converter dolly, and breakdown vehicle.
formatted: A **goods vehicle** is a motor vehicle (other than a motorcycle, tricycle, quadrucycle, motor car, minibus, or bus) designed to **carry goods on a public road**; it includes a **truck-tractor, adaptor dolly, converter dolly, and breakdown vehicle**.

raw: Gross Combination Mass (GCM) is the maximum mass of a vehicle combination (including the drawing vehicle) and its load, as specified by the manufacturer or, failing that, the registering authority.
formatted: **Gross Combination Mass (GCM)** is the **maximum mass** of a vehicle combination (including drawing vehicle) and its load, as specified by the **manufacturer or registering authority**.

raw: Gross Vehicle Mass (GVM) is the maximum mass of a vehicle and its load, as specified by the manufacturer or, failing that, the registering authority.
formatted: **Gross Vehicle Mass (GVM)** is the **maximum mass** of a vehicle and its load, as specified by the **manufacturer or registering authority**.

raw: A haulage tractor is a motor vehicle designed mainly for drawing other vehicles, with a GCM exceeding 24,000kg; it does not include a truck-tractor or tractor.
formatted: A **haulage tractor** is a motor vehicle designed mainly for drawing other vehicles, with a **GCM exceeding 24,000kg**; it does not include a truck-tractor or tractor.

raw: An intersection is the area where two or more public roads open to vehicular traffic join or cross at any angle.
formatted: An **intersection** is the area where **two or more public roads** open to vehicular traffic **join or cross at any angle**.

raw: A minibus is a motor vehicle designed to carry more than nine but not more than 16 people, including the driver.
formatted: A **minibus** is a motor vehicle designed to carry **more than nine but not more than 16 people**, including the driver.

raw: A motor car is a motor vehicle (other than a motorcycle, tricycle, or quadrucycle) designed to carry not more than nine people, including the driver.
formatted: A **motor car** is a motor vehicle (other than a motorcycle, tricycle, or quadrucycle) designed to carry **not more than nine people**, including the driver.

raw: A motor quadrucycle is a motor vehicle (other than a tractor) with four wheels, designed to be driven using motorcycle-type controls.
formatted: A **motor quadrucycle** is a motor vehicle (other than a tractor) with four wheels, designed to be driven using **motorcycle-type controls**.

raw: A motor tricycle is a motor vehicle (other than a motorcycle or tractor) with three wheels, designed to be driven using motorcycle-type controls.
formatted: A **motor tricycle** is a motor vehicle (other than a motorcycle or tractor) with three wheels, designed to be driven using **motorcycle-type controls**.

raw: A motor vehicle is any self-propelled vehicle, including a trailer and a pedal-and-motor vehicle designed to be propelled by pedals, an engine, or both.
formatted: A **motor vehicle** is any **self-propelled vehicle**, including a trailer and a pedal-and-motor vehicle designed to be propelled by pedals, an engine, or both.

raw: A number plate is a prescribed plate displaying a vehicle's licence number or a motor trade number.
formatted: A **number plate** is a prescribed plate displaying a vehicle's **licence number or motor trade number**.

raw: A pedestrian crossing is a portion of road designated as such by a sign, or, absent a sign, the portion at an intersection within the extension of the kerb line and adjacent boundary line.
formatted: A **pedestrian crossing** is a portion of road designated as such by a sign, or, absent a sign, the portion at an intersection within the extension of the **kerb line and adjacent boundary line**.

raw: A public road is any road, street, or thoroughfare commonly used by, or open to, the public, including its verge and any bridge, ferry, or drift it crosses.
formatted: A **public road** is any road, street, or thoroughfare **commonly used by, or open to, the public**, including its verge and any bridge, ferry, or drift it crosses.

raw: A retro-reflector is a reflector complying with SABS specification 513, bearing a certification or approval mark.
formatted: A **retro-reflector** is a reflector complying with **SABS specification 513**, bearing a certification or approval mark.

raw: A road traffic sign is a sign for prohibiting, limiting, regulating, or controlling traffic (in general or a particular class) on a public road.
formatted: A **road traffic sign** is a sign for **prohibiting, limiting, regulating, or controlling traffic** (in general or a particular class) on a public road.

raw: The roadway is the portion of a road built or intended for vehicular traffic, between the edges of the roadway.
formatted: The **roadway** is the portion of a road built or intended for **vehicular traffic**, between the edges of the roadway.

raw: A semi-trailer is a trailer with no front axle, designed so at least 15% of its tare is borne by the vehicle drawing it.
formatted: A **semi-trailer** is a trailer with no front axle, designed so **at least 15% of its tare** is borne by the vehicle drawing it.

raw: The shoulder is the portion of road between the edge of the roadway and the kerb line.
formatted: The **shoulder** is the portion of road between the **edge of the roadway and the kerb line**.

raw: Tare, for a vehicle, is its mass ready to travel on a road, including standard accessories and permanent structural parts, but excluding fuel.
formatted: **Tare**, for a vehicle, is its mass **ready to travel on a road**, including standard accessories and permanent structural parts, but **excluding fuel**.

raw: A traffic island is a physical island that channels traffic within a junction or on a public road.
formatted: A **traffic island** is a physical island that **channels traffic** within a junction or on a public road.

raw: A traffic lane is a longitudinal division of a road wide enough for a single line of vehicles.
formatted: A **traffic lane** is a longitudinal division of a road wide enough for a **single line of vehicles**.

raw: An urban area is a local authority area that has been surveyed and subdivided into erven, including the public roads bordering it.
formatted: An **urban area** is a local authority area that has been **surveyed and subdivided into erven**, including the public roads bordering it.

raw: A verge is the portion of a road, including the sidewalk, that is not the roadway or the shoulder.
formatted: A **verge** is the portion of a road, including the sidewalk, that is **not the roadway or the shoulder**.

raw: LMV means Light Motor Vehicle -- tare/GVM not exceeding 3500kg.
formatted: **LMV** means Light Motor Vehicle -- tare/GVM **not exceeding 3500kg**.

raw: HMV means Heavy Motor Vehicle -- tare exceeds 3500kg, or a minibus/bus/goods vehicle GVM exceeds 3500kg, or an articulated/combination vehicle's GCM (or trailer GVM) exceeds the prescribed thresholds.
formatted: **HMV** means Heavy Motor Vehicle -- tare **exceeds 3500kg**, or a minibus/bus/goods vehicle GVM exceeds 3500kg, or an articulated/combination vehicle's GCM (or trailer GVM) exceeds prescribed thresholds.

raw: MC means Motorcycle, and includes a motorcycle, tricycle, and quadrucycle.
formatted: **MC** means Motorcycle, and includes a **motorcycle, tricycle, and quadrucycle**.

raw: After being involved in or contributing to an accident, a driver must stop immediately, check for and assist with any injuries, and assess the damage.
formatted:
After being involved in or contributing to an accident, a driver must:
(i) **stop immediately**,
(ii) **check for and assist** with any injuries, and
(iii) **assess the damage**.

raw: A driver may not hold a cellular or other communication device in one or both hands, or with any other part of the body, while driving.
formatted: A driver may **not hold a cellular or communication device** in one or both hands, or with any other part of the body, **while driving**.

raw: Goods may not be loaded so that they touch the road surface, or obstruct the driver's view to the front, either side, or in the rear-view mirror.
formatted:
Goods may not be loaded so that they:
(i) **touch the road surface**, or
(ii) **obstruct the driver's view** to the front, either side, or in the rear-view mirror.

raw: No person may drive a motor vehicle on a public road except under a licence issued in terms of the National Road Traffic Act, and must keep that licence (or document) with them in the vehicle.
formatted: No person may drive a motor vehicle on a public road except under a **licence issued in terms of the Act**, and must **keep that licence with them** in the vehicle.

raw: A licence to drive a motor vehicle is issued by a driving licence testing centre, and is either a provisional licence (a learner's licence) or a full driving licence.
formatted: A driving licence is issued by a DLTC and is either a **provisional licence (learner's)** or a **full driving licence**.

raw: A learner's licence application is made at a DLTC on form LL1, accompanied by two identical photos, acceptable identification (plus a copy), and the appropriate fee; applicants 65 or older must also submit a medical certificate (form MC) from a medical practitioner or occupational health practitioner.
formatted:
A learner's licence application requirements:
(i) apply at a DLTC on **form LL1** with two identical photos, **acceptable ID (plus copy)**, and the fee, and
(ii) applicants **65 or older** must also submit a **medical certificate (form MC)** from a registered practitioner.

raw: A licence holder who permanently changes their place of residence must notify the registering authority of their new residential and postal address within 14 days.
formatted: A licence holder who permanently changes residence must **notify the registering authority** of their new address **within 14 days**.

raw: An owner, operator, or person in charge of a vehicle may not employ or permit anyone to drive it on a public road unless that person is licensed to drive it.
