raw: Read the message on the road and then concentrate on the possible danger indicated by the message.
formatted: **Read the message on the road** and **concentrate on the possible danger** indicated.

raw: Driver must focus on the signals given by the officer, and strictly adhere to the signal given. The traffic officer signals takes precedence over any other traffic signal. a) Stop-Stop traffic approaching from the front b) Stop-Stop traffic approaching from the rear c) Stop-Stop traffic approaching from the rear d) Go/Proceed - Indicates to the driver that he/she may proceed e) Go/Proceed - Indicates to the driver that he/she may proceed
formatted:
Traffic officer signals take precedence:
(i) **Stop signals** require stopping when indicated from front or rear, and
(ii) **Go/Proceed signals** indicate that the driver may proceed.

raw: If your vehicle belongs to the company or organisation indicated by this sign, obey the regulatory sign.
formatted: If your vehicle **belongs to the company or organisation** indicated, **obey the regulatory sign**.

raw: Do not turn in at such a road unless you are going to a destination in the road that ends.
formatted: **Do not turn in at such a road** unless going to a **destination in the road that ends**.

raw: Stop or proceed depending on the displayed flag signal.
formatted: **Stop or proceed** depending on the **displayed flag signal**.

raw: The driver must leave the lane in the direction of the arrow.
formatted: The driver **must leave the lane** in the **direction of the arrow**.

raw: Proceed slowly and be alert.
formatted: **Proceed slowly and be alert**.

raw: Choose the correct lane in time to drive in the direction that you want to go.
formatted: **Choose the correct lane in time** to drive in the direction that you want to go.

raw: Ensure not to cross the prohibition line that follows the sign. If you are on the right-hand side of the road move back to the left-hand lane as soon as possible before the prohibition line starts.
formatted:
Prohibition line warning:
(i) **do not cross the prohibition line** that follows the sign, and
(ii) if on the right-hand side, **move back to the left lane** before the line starts.

raw: Only drive into this arrestor bed when your brakes fail.
formatted: **Only drive into this arrestor bed** when your **brakes fail**.

raw: Obey the primary sign according to the direction indicated.
formatted: **Obey the primary sign** according to the **direction indicated**.

raw: Pay the parking fee and display the receipt on or within your vehicle.
formatted: **Pay the parking fee** and **display the receipt on or within your vehicle**.

raw: Only leave the freeway if you are in the left-hand lane.
formatted: **Only leave the freeway** if you are in the **left-hand lane**.

raw: Make use of this advance direction sign to decide where you want to go before reaching actual intersection.
formatted: **Use this advance sign** to **decide your route** before reaching the actual intersection.

raw: Whenever a lane ends, converges, merges or is added, make sure in time that there is a big enough gap in the traffic to merge with the traffic. Also yield to other traffic, which might merge.
formatted: Whenever a lane ends, converges, merges or is added, **ensure a sufficient traffic gap to merge** in time, and **yield to other merging traffic**.

raw: Always pass on the left-hand side of this road traffic sign if you want to leave the freeway and on the right-hand side if you do not want to leave.
formatted:
Gore sign positioning:
(i) **pass on the left-hand side** if you want to leave the freeway, and
(ii) **pass on the right-hand side** if you do not want to leave.

raw: Do not use the road or part of the road indicated by this sign. Pedestrians may use only the part of the road indicated by this sign.
formatted: **Do not use the road** or part indicated by this sign. **Pedestrians may use only the part** indicated.

raw: Do not use the road or part of the road indicated by this sign. Cyclists may use only the part of the road indicated by this sign.
formatted: **Do not use the road** or part indicated by this sign. **Cyclists may use only the part** indicated.

raw: Switch the lights of your vehicle on in the dip position.
formatted: **Switch the lights of your vehicle on** in the **dip position**.

raw: Do not use this road or parking area if you are not driving a bus, midi bus or minibus.
formatted: **Do not use this road or parking area** if you are not driving a **bus, midi bus or minibus**.

raw: Look out for cyclists and pedestrians who use the road despite the prohibition. Cyclists and pedestrians must follow a different route and may not proceed beyond this sign.
formatted: Cyclists and pedestrians **must follow a different route** and **may not proceed beyond**. Drivers must **look out for prohibited users**.

raw: Yield right of way to vehicle approaching from the right within the roundabout, where such vehicles are close enough to cause a danger or potential danger. Proceed clockwise at the junction if it is safe to do so.
formatted:
Roundabout navigation:
(i) **yield right of way** to vehicles approaching from the right close enough to pose danger, and
(ii) **proceed clockwise at the junction** when safe.

raw: Do not proceed past the sign or enter the road without special permission.
formatted: **Do not proceed past the sign** or enter the road **without special permission**.

raw: If sign R214 or TR214 is displayed, do not overtake any vehicle for the next 500m. If you are driving a heavy motor vehicle, do not overtake another heavy vehicle if sign R215 is displayed.
formatted:
No overtaking rules:
(i) if R214/TR214 is displayed, **do not overtake any vehicle** for the next 500m, and
(ii) if R215 is displayed on a heavy vehicle, **do not overtake another heavy vehicle**.

raw: Look out for cyclists who use the road despite the prohibition. Cyclists must follow a different route and may not proceed beyond this sign.
formatted: Cyclists **must follow a different route** and **may not proceed beyond**. Drivers must **look out for prohibited cyclists**.

raw: Do not use this road or parking area if you are not driving an ambulance or emergency vehicle.
formatted: **Do not use this road or parking area** if you are not driving an **ambulance or emergency vehicle**.

raw: Do not follow this bus route if you are not driving a bus.
formatted: **Do not follow this bus route** if you are **not driving a bus**.

raw: From here you do not have to comply with the restriction sign with a symbol similar to this sign but without the red cross.
formatted: From here **you do not have to comply** with the restriction sign **matching this symbol**.

raw: Do not use this road or parking area if you are not driving a minibus.
formatted: **Do not use this road or parking area** if you are not driving a **minibus**.

raw: Do not use this road or parking area if you are not driving a goods vehicle.
formatted: **Do not use this road or parking area** if you are not driving a **goods vehicle**.

raw: Slow down and be on the look out for the next 2 km for animals.
formatted: **Slow down** and **be on the look out for animals** for the next 2 km.

raw: Drive slowly, obey the special rules mentioned above and be particularly on the look out for children playing in the street.
formatted: **Drive slowly**, obey special zone rules, and **be on the lookout for children playing** in the street.

raw: If possible enter the exit at the same speed as the maximum speed for that road.
formatted: If possible, **enter the exit at the same speed** as the **maximum speed for that road**.

raw: Pay attention to these signs in order to realise what the danger is, what a safe speed is, how far away the danger is and the distance the danger will continue.
formatted: Pay attention to these signs to realise the **nature of danger**, **safe speed**, and **distance/length of danger**.

raw: Do not enter this area if the overall width of the vehicle you are driving exceeds the width indicated on the sign.
formatted: **Do not enter this area** if overall vehicle width **exceeds the width indicated** on the sign.

raw: Do not enter this area or park here if you are not driving a bus.
formatted: **Do not enter this area or park here** if you are **not driving a bus**.

raw: Exception an emergency, you may stop for short periods, but may not park here. Parking means that a vehicle is stationary (whether the engine is running or not) for a longer period than is longer than that needed to on or off load goods or passengers.
formatted: Except in an emergency, you **may stop for short periods** but **may not park here**.

raw: Look out for any pedestrians crossing or wanting to cross the road and give them priority by slowing down or stopping.
formatted: **Look out for crossing pedestrians** and give them priority by **slowing down or stopping**.

raw: If you are driving in the left hand lane and want to turn to the right at the first intersection, change to the right hand lane in good time. If you are driving in the right hand lane and wish to turn to the left at the first intersection, change to the left hand lane in good time.
formatted:
Lane positioning before two-way cross street:
(i) if driving in the left lane and turning right, **change to the right lane in good time**, and
(ii) if driving in the right lane and turning left, **change to the left lane in good time**.

raw: Do not drive on this road or part of this road. Cyclists and pedestrians may use only that part of the road indicated by these signs. Where this part of the road is divided, cyclists may use the part indicated on the sign by a bicycle symbol. Pedestrians may use the part indicated on the sign by a pedestrian symbol.
formatted:
Pedestrian and cycle path usage:
(i) **do not drive a motor vehicle** on this road or designated path,
(ii) cyclists and pedestrians **must use only their designated portions**, and
(iii) on divided paths, **cyclists use the bicycle section** and **pedestrians use the pedestrian section**.

raw: The driver of an abnormal vehicle shall only use such road or portion of such road.
formatted: The driver of an **abnormal vehicle** shall **only use such road** or portion of such road.

raw: If applicable, take an alternative route.
formatted: If applicable, **take an alternative route**.

raw: Despite the fact that pedestrians are prohibited on such a road, you must still look out for them. Pedestrians may not enter or cross a road where this sign is displayed.
formatted: Pedestrians **may not enter or cross** where displayed. Drivers **must still look out for pedestrians**.

raw: Do not enter this area if you are towing another vehicle or trailer.
formatted: **Do not enter this area** if you are **towing another vehicle or trailer**.

raw: Park in accordance with the road traffic sign and road traffic markings. If necessary pay the tariff and do not park for longer than the time indicated.
formatted: **Park in accordance with signs and markings**. Pay applicable tariffs and **do not exceed allowed time limits**.

raw: Slow down e3nough to take the curves safely or stop within the distance you can see. Remember that there could be any number of curves after the first one without further warning.
formatted: **Slow down enough** to **take curves safely or stop within sight distance**. Note that **unwarned curves may follow**.

raw: Slow down and be prepared to stop or turn at a safe speed. Look out for traffic at the intersection that might not yield.
formatted: **Slow down** and **be prepared to stop or turn** at a safe speed. **Look out for non-yielding traffic**.

raw: Find an alternative route if your vehicle is longer that the length indicated in metres on this sign.
formatted: **Find an alternative route** if your vehicle is **longer than the length indicated** in metres.

raw: Be aware of slow-moving traffic, particularly in mountainous areas with sharp curves. Allow for a longer stopping distance on a descent and especially when your vehicle is heavily laden.
formatted: **Be aware of slow-moving traffic**. Allow for a **longer stopping distance on descents**, especially when heavily laden.

raw: Whenever a lane ends, converges, merges or is added, make sure in time that there is a big enough gap in the traffic to merge with the traffic. Also yield to other traffic, which might merge.
formatted: Whenever a lane ends, converges, merges or is added, **ensure a sufficient traffic gap to merge** in time, and **yield to other merging traffic**.

raw: Slow down so that you can stop or yield if there is cross traffic that do not yield at the intersection. Remember that a driver of such a vehicle that joins your road from the concealed driveway sometimes finds it also difficult to see you.
formatted: **Slow down** so you can stop or yield if cross traffic fails to yield. Remember **drivers joining from concealed driveways may struggle to see you**.

raw: Slow down to be able to stop within their sight distance if a fall occurs or has occurred. Such falls occur more often when it rains and therefore reduce your speed further since your stopping distance during rainy weather will be longer.
formatted: **Slow down** to stop within sight distance if rockfalls occur. **Reduce speed further in rain** as stopping distances increase.

raw: Slow down and look out for anything on or next to the carriageway that could cause you to change speed or direction.
formatted: **Slow down** and **look out for anything** that could cause you to **change speed or direction**.

raw: These lights must be obeyed at all times in the following manner: Red - Stop. Flashing red arrow to the left - After stopping, the driver may turn if there is no traffic. Remember to yield to pedestrian traffic and oncoming traffic that wants to turn right, and traffic from the right passing through the intersection. Amber - Stop, except where it cannot be done safely. Constant amber arrow - Stop and wait until the flashing green arrow shows you may go. Green - Go if it is safe. Flashing green arrows - Right of way in the direction of the flashing arrow. Constant green arrow - Shows the direction in which traffic must go, for example one-way streets. Flashing amber disc - Drive on carefully, but yield to pedestrians. Pedestrians may cross the roadway. Flashing red signal - Indicates that the driver must stop and may carry on when it is safe (as at stop sign). At a railway crossing a flashing red light indicates that a train is coming and you may not drive on until the light stops flashing. (Red) figure light signal. Shows pedestrians that they may not cross the road until the green figure light signal is shown. If this sign flashes pedestrians who have not entered the roadway must wait until a green figure light signal shows. Pedestrians who are already in the intersection must cross the intersection as quickly as possible.
formatted:
Traffic light rules:
(i) **Red**: Stop; **Flashing red arrow left**: Stop, then turn if clear (yield to pedestrians, oncoming right-turners, right-side traffic),
(ii) **Amber**: Stop unless unsafe; **Constant amber arrow**: Stop and wait for green arrow; **Green**: Go if safe,
(iii) **Flashing green arrow**: Right of way in arrow direction; **Constant green arrow**: Mandatory movement direction; **Flashing amber disc**: Drive carefully and yield to pedestrians,
(iv) **Flashing red signal**: Stop, then proceed when safe (like a stop sign); **Flashing red at railway crossing**: Stop until flashing stops, and
(v) **Red figure**: Pedestrians do not cross; **Flashing red figure**: Pedestrians in roadway cross quickly, those waiting do not enter.

raw: Be ready to stop at the stop sign that follows after the flashing blue light or on demand of a police officer.
formatted: **Be ready to stop** at the stop sign following the flashing blue light or **on demand of a police officer**.

raw: Slow down immediately, look out for someone controlling the traffic and be ready to stop. If there is enough or professional help on the scene, do not stop out of curiosity. Do not look at the collision scene or wreckage, concentrate on the route to be followed without driving over or into anything.
formatted:
Accident scene instructions:
(i) **slow down immediately**, look for traffic controllers, and **be ready to stop**,
(ii) if help is present, **do not stop out of curiosity**, and
(iii) **do not gawk at wreckage**; focus on your route to avoid debris.

raw: Slow down so that you will be able to stop, or go around the corner or pass the intersection at a safe speed. Look out for other traffic at the intersection that might not yield.
formatted: **Slow down** so you can stop, turn, or pass at a safe speed. **Look out for non-yielding traffic** at the intersection.

raw: Slow down so that you can stop or drive around the circle at a safe speed. Look out for road traffic signs and markings which will tell you whether you have the right of way or whether you have to yield. If there is no indication you have to give way to traffic approaching from the right. Vehicles within a traffic circle have right of way. If you have right of way still look out for traffic in the circle which may not yield to you. If sign R2.2 is displayed at the traffic circle, you must yield to any driver who crosses his yield line first before you cross yours.
formatted:
Circle approach rules:
(i) **slow down** to stop or navigate the circle safely,
(ii) **yield to traffic approaching from the right** (vehicles in circle have right of way unless signs specify otherwise), and
(iii) if sign R2.2 is present, **yield to any driver who crosses their yield line first**.

raw: Slow down and look out for a stop sign displayed by the scholar patrol. Look out at all times for children who may suddenly cross the road.
formatted: **Slow down** and **look out for stop signs** displayed by the scholar patrol. **Watch for children** who may suddenly cross.
